title: Localized counit comparison transport between derived tensor models
statement: Let $R,A,B,D$ be commutative rings, let $A,B$ be $R$-algebras, put $E=A\otimes_R B$, and let $D$ be an $E$-algebra [def-weil-module-base-change]. Choose derived categories of $R$- and $B$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $s:P\to G$ be a quasi-isomorphism of cochain complexes of $A$-modules, and choose models $M_P,M_G$ of their base-derived tensor cohomology [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. For every $i\in\mathbf Z$ there is an $E$-linear isomorphism $e:T_{P,i}\simeq T_{G,i}$ such that $c_{P,i}\gg H^i(D\otimes_A s)=(D\otimes_E e)\gg c_{G,i}$. Here $c$ is the localizedComparison field, and the $A\to D$ map is $A\to E\to D$. No comparison map or ordinary tensor map is assumed invertible.

source.place: Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change, independence of choices; perfect.tex equation-bc before Tag 0DJ8, canonical comparison

proof.text: Apply the ordinary comparison transport theorem to obtain e and the square for comparison. No extension to D has been performed at this point.

Prove the ordinaryToLocalized chain square directly. Use hom_ext and ExtendScalars.hom_ext to test on 1 tensor q. Its two routes both send this tensor to the image of 1 tensor s(q), by ordinaryToLocalized_tmul and ExtendScalars.map_tmul. Apply homology. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality transports this square through restriction of D-modules to E-modules.

Use injectivity of the extension/restriction adjunction hom equivalence. Its left and right naturality laws turn the desired localized square into a square of transposes. Replace these transposes by localized_eq; the chain square of the preceding step and the ordinary comparison square, followed by reassociation, prove equality. The source isomorphism after extension to D is the functor image of e.
